text: こんにちは。今日はいい天気ですね。
次の会議は午後三時からです。資料を確認して、気になる点があれば教えてください。
音声アシスタントを快適に使うには、自然な声と素早い応答の両方が大切です。今回は同じ文章を複数の音声モデルで読み上げて、生成にかかる時間を比較します。日本語だけでなく英語でも、短い返事から少し長い説明まで確認します。
Hello. The weather is lovely today.
Our next meeting starts at three in the afternoon. Please review the documents and let me know if you have any questions.

A comfortable voice assistant needs both natural speech and quick responses. In this experiment, several speech models read the same sentences so that we can compare their generation times. We test short replies and longer explanations in both Japanese and English. The goal is to find a practical model for everyday conversations on this computer.
